blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: For 4D reconstruction, a synchronized multi-camera rig records all views at the same timestamps and misses the motion between them. Staggered triggers spread the same frames over more timestamps. However, when the cameras along each row fire one after another, as in 4DSloMo's schedule on the N3DV rig, the row acts as one moving camera that confounds depth with motion. We introduce OffBeat, which models a staggered rig as a spatially distributed multicoset sampler: shifted copies of one sampling grid. From the calibration alone, OffBeat derives camera groups that fire together and their firing order. Since one group records each timestamp, a short-lived primitive can fit an error its cameras share, such as a color offset, and flicker in novel views. We show that a primitive's opacity over time weights all groups equally, for every number of groups, only if it lasts at least one camera frame interval. On Spacetime Gaussians, a minimum lifetime approximates this bound, and a closed-form smoothed box of that length satisfies it exactly, with less flicker than a Gaussian in its place at nearly equal PSNR. In simulated staggered capture on N3DV, OffBeat outperforms the full 4DSloMo pipeline with video diffusion on every test frame, by 3.04 dB in mean dynamic-region PSNR. Between the first and last synchronized frame, it outperforms the best synchronized method of each scene, with or without frame interpolation, by 1.98 dB in mean dynamic-region PSNR, while synchronized capture is better at its own frames. On PanopticSports, in this frame range, OffBeat is comparable in PSNR to synchronized capture with interpolation. On every N3DV scene, replacing 4DSloMo's schedule with ours raises the dynamic-region PSNR of Spacetime Gaussians, 4DSloMo without diffusion, and our reconstruction. Multi-camera rigs could follow faster motion at the same frame count by changing only when each camera fires.

blocks.en: 4D reconstruction from multi-view video [ 20 , 22 , 47 ] still fails on fast non-rigid motion, such as a flame, a hand turning food, or a ball leaving a hand. One cause is temporal sampling: in a synchronized rig, all N N cameras record at the same timestamps, once every camera frame interval T T . Adding cameras adds views of these timestamps and leaves the temporal bandwidth at 1 / ( 2 ​ T ) 1/(2T) . A higher frame rate costs resolution, exposure, storage and link bandwidth.

blocks.en: We model a staggered rig as a spatially distributed multicoset sampler [ 28 , 41 ] : cameras that fire together form a trigger group and sample at the camera frame rate on a shifted copy of one grid. As in multichannel sampling, a point whose motion is band-limited to half the effective frame rate K / T K/T is identifiable if every group triangulates it (Sec. 3.1 ). Single-camera groups, as on N3DV, cannot triangulate; a motion model over one camera frame interval pools them. From the calibration alone, we choose the groups by how well the others triangulate, and their order by the predictive variance of novel views (Sec. 3.2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们把一个交错的钻机作为空间分布的多相机采样机[28,41]: 相机一起发射,在一个网格的转动复制上以相机帧速率形成一个触发组和样本. 如同在多通道采样中一样,如果每个组的三角形都能够确定一个点,其运动范围限制在有效帧速率K / T K/T的一半(第3.1节)。 单相机组,如同N3DV一样,不能三角化;在一个相机帧间隔上的运动模型将它们集合起来. 单从校准中,我们根据其他三角形的精度来选择各组,根据新观点的预测差异来选择各组(第3.2条)。

blocks.en:
The reconstruction faces a second problem: as each timestamp is recorded by a single group, an error its cameras share, such as a color or calibration offset, is fit exactly by spurious content present only at those timestamps, which a novel view sees as flicker at the camera frame rate (Sec. 3.3 ). A primitive can supply such content in every period only if its temporal opacity window, summed over copies one period apart, weights the groups unequally. We show that the windows weighting all groups equally for any number of groups and at any center are exactly the convolutions of a box of length T T (Prop. 1 ).
Hence a primitive’s lifetime (its window’s duration) is at least T T rather than the trigger spacing T / K T/K , while its motion is sampled at the effective frame rate. On Spacetime Gaussians (STG) [ 22 ] , a lifetime floor approximates this bound, and a closed-form period window , a smoothed box, satisfies it exactly (Sec. 3.4 ).

blocks.en: In summary, we make the following contributions: • We introduce OffBeat, which models a staggered rig as a spatially distributed multicoset sampler, and show that a position-ordered row confounds depth with motion. • From the calibration alone, we derive which cameras fire together and in which order. • We show that temporal windows weighting all groups equally for every K K must last at least T T , and derive a closed-form period window that satisfies this bound. • In simulated staggered capture on N3DV, OffBeat outperforms the full 4DSloMo pipeline and follows motion between synchronized frames better on average than a synchronized rig of equal camera frame rate, which is better at its own frames. On PanopticSports, up to the last synchronized frame, OffBeat is comparable in PSNR to synchronized capture with interpolation.

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: In high-speed arrays of nearly co-located cameras [ 46 , 37 , 1 ] , the firing order is a design parameter [ 46 ] . Color-coded illumination yields high-speed 3D under controlled light [ 27 ] . Methods for unsynchronized video treat the time offsets as nuisances under smoothness priors [ 3 , 29 , 42 , 52 ] , estimate them [ 8 , 2 , 15 , 48 , 19 , 53 ] , or recover structure and motion from asynchronous tracks [ 11 , 39 ] . 4DSloMo [ 9 ] staggers a rig with a modular schedule.

blocks.en: In multichannel sampling, K K channels at 1 / K 1/K of the Nyquist rate recover a band-limited signal [ 28 , 41 ] . Parallel MRI shares this structure [ 30 , 40 ] , and CAIPIRINHA [ 7 ] shifts the sampling pattern such that aliases fall where the coil sensitivities differ. Our ordering criterion plays this role for cameras by decorrelating the trigger offsets from the camera positions.

blocks.en: Dynamic extensions of Gaussian splatting [ 13 ] use deformation fields [ 47 ] , native 4D primitives [ 49 ] , per-Gaussian trajectories with temporal opacity [ 22 , 18 , 45 ] , or tracked Gaussians [ 24 ] . RetimeGS [ 44 ] and SPIN-4DGS [ 16 ] target temporal aliasing and large displacements between synchronized frames. Mip-Splatting [ 50 ] bounds the 3D frequency of a primitive by the sampling rate of the training views, and our lifetime bound is its temporal counterpart. SharpTimeGS [ 23 ] learns a flat-top lifespan for each primitive to balance static and dynamic content, whereas our window’s box has the derived length T T .

In a synchronized rig, h h is constant. A test camera belongs to no group and sees h h as flicker at the camera frame rate and its harmonics (Fig. 4 , Sec. 4.4 ). blocks.en: N3DV [ 20 ] contains six dynamic scenes. We hold out camera 0 for testing and train on the other 17–20 cameras. Following 4DSloMo [ 9 ] , we subsample each 30 fps video to every 12th frame (2.5 fps), with a separate offset per camera for staggered capture and a common one for synchronized capture. We report test frames 100–159 unless stated otherwise and validate on frames 40–99 of Flame Steak and Cook Spinach. PanopticSports [ 12 , 24 ] has 27 training and 4 test cameras, and we use six sequences with test frames 0–59 and K = 12 K{=}12 , validating on frames 90–149 of Softball and Basketball. Each method is trained once per scene, and Sec. S6 reports three seeds.

blocks.en: For synchronized capture, we train STG and STG + interpolation , STG trained on videos in which AMT [ 21 ] fills the 11 frames between synchronized frames. RetimeGS [ 44 ] , for which we found no public code, reports this recipe with FILM [ 32 ] as its strongest N3DV baseline, 0.05 dB below its own result. For staggered capture, we compare OffBeat with STG, also trained with twice the iterations, and with 4DSloMo [ 9 ] , using its official code and settings. We run its reconstruction stage, a native 4D Gaussian model [ 49 ] , on both schedules and on the synchronized frames of N3DV (where it is weaker than STG); we run its full pipeline with video diffusion on all six N3DV scenes (Sec. S5). All STG-based methods share the initialization, renderer and clock alignment (Sec. S8) and are trained for 10k iterations unless stated otherwise. OffBeat trains in 423–481 s per scene on one RTX 4090.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented OffBeat, a 4D capture method that models a staggered rig as a multicoset sampler to follow motion a synchronized rig misses. Under this model, a position-ordered row confounds depth with motion, the calibration alone yields a schedule, and temporal windows weighting all groups equally for every K K last at least T T , a bound our closed-form period window satisfies. On N3DV, OffBeat outperforms the full 4DSloMo pipeline in dynamic-region and full-frame PSNR on every test frame. Between the first and last synchronized frame, it follows motion better on average than a synchronized rig of equal camera frame rate, which is better at its own frames. On PanopticSports, in the same range, OffBeat is comparable in PSNR to synchronized capture with interpolation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了OffBeat,一种4D捕捉方法 将交错的钻机作为多套采样机 跟踪同步钻机的移动 在这个模型下,一个位置顺序的行会与运动的深度相混淆,光是校准就会产生一个时间表,时间窗口将每K K 重置所有组,至少是T T ,一个捆绑的封闭式周期窗口满足了. 在 N3DV 上, OffBeat 超越了全部 4DSlo Mo 管道在动态区域 和全框架 PSNR 每个测试框架。 在第一个和最后一个同步帧之间,它平均跟随运动比一个等相机帧速率的同步钻机更好,这在它自己的帧上更好. 在PanopticSports上,OffBeat在PSNR中具有可比性,可以与插值同步捕获.

blocks.en: We simulate staggered capture by subsampling 30 fps video, and the schedule needs calibration before capture. On 4DSloMo’s real staggered recording, we test only the lifetime floor, in its reconstruction stage, and find no reliable gain. In that stage, the period window as used on STG lowers dynamic-region PSNR on an N3DV validation scene (Sec. S5). OffBeat is more sensitive than synchronized STG to simulated trigger-time and photometric errors, which a real rig adds (Secs. S7 and S8). Estimating trigger times and gains during reconstruction could lower this sensitivity. Content shorter than T T cannot be represented, and the fastest motion between a group’s firings stays blurred. OffBeat fails on Juggle at one PanopticSports camera (Sec. S6).
blocks.zh: 我们通过对30英尺的视频进行子抽样模拟错位捕获,时间表在捕获前需要校准. 在4DSloMo真实的交错录制中, 在那个阶段,STG上使用的时段窗口在N3DV验证场景(Sec. S5)上降低动态区域PSNR. OffBeat比同步STG更敏感,可以模拟触发时间和光度测定错误,而真实的钻机会添加(Secs. S7和S8). 估计重建期间的触发时间和收益会降低这种敏感性。 内容短于T T 无法被代表,一个团体射击之间的最快动作仍然模糊不清. OffBeat在一台PanopticSports相机(Sec. S6)的Juggle上失败.
